name: opencode-driver
description: Driver for the OpenCode agent harness. Reconstructed 2026-09-05 from package-lock.json, which had recorded these exact dependencies all along -- the manifest itself was never committed, so the tree only resolved because driver/node_modules happened to be present. Without this file `npm ci` cannot run on a fresh checkout. "type": "module" is REQUIRED and is not recorded in the lock file: @opencode-ai/sdk is ESM-only (exports has an "import" condition and no "main"), so without it Node resolves run.ts through the CJS loader and every cell dies on ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. The directory had no package.json at all before, which is why this never surfaced until 2026-09-07.
